test_title: SSC CGL 2021 Tier-I (Held On : 19 April 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: In a certain code language, ‘LILY’ is coded as 116, and ‘LOTUS’ is coded as 174. How will ‘TULIP’ be coded in that language?
solution:
The position of letters according to the English alphabet series:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9b1ef5af07dc7cdface0347994bbc6f824cbda2bac27bcab0cb4cf07968dfa00.png] 

**Logic: Addition of place of alphabet × 2 = Number.**

‘LILY’ is coded as 116

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ecc11d6c07711c75d4d9d6feb603d386e34990864268ea372b2c4f88ff7e3dc5.png] 

And,

‘LOTUS’ is coded as 174

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/00cf5c6565ad98032c8f4b0e2b594b144815bcf2f5838cc2492882368eb338ef.png] 

Similarly,

‘TULIP’ be coded as '?'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f14c0aeff65404de6525538d656ddaf792f740f6c1f14077d2d8ac493d4ec80e.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"156".**
